mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing during a recession, which reduces the discount rate for future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate was 0.15% as of 2009-01-01
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% for 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in walk-forward IC tests (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in residential construction permits below 550,000 units signals a collapse in housing demand, which reduces confidence in broader economic recovery and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST < 550.0, or the signal shows no predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03) in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 90.0 index points for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 90.0 for two months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based collapse in private demand, which triggers a flight to safety and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 550.0, RSAFS was 344649.0 as of 2009-01-01
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where both HOUST < 550.0 and RSAFS < 330000.0, or the interaction term fails to show incremental predictive power (IC difference < 0.02) over individual proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers expectations of future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL was 211.398 (YoY change ~1.5% based on prior data)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS >= 0.15%, or the interaction effect does not improve predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market breakdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS was 134580.0, UNRATE was 7.6% as of 2009-01-01
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal fails to outperform individual proxies (IC difference < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11,600 billion chained dollars, combined with a decline in industrial production, signals a deepening recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 < 11600 and INDPRO < 90.0, or the interaction effect does not show incremental predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).
